Alienism.description: The Alienism powers come from entities existing outside the normal flow of space and time. These ancient and bizarre entities are utterly alien in their thought processes. The miracles of the Alienism faith bend the laws of physics, space, and sanity, calling upon these eldritch beings for reality-warping effects.
Alienism.name: Alienism

Body Alteration.description: The Body Alteration Super Power FX broad skill is a collection of Super Power FX that alter a hero's form or how a hero interacts with other physical matter. Size changes, shape alteration, extra arms, stretching, invisibility, and passing through solid objects are all powers of this type. Body Alteration powers require either a high Will to initiate and control these changes or a high Constitution to endure the stresses they place upon the body.
Body Alteration.name: Body Alteration

Brick.description: The Brick Super Power FX broad skill is a collection of abilities that enhance the body's ability to resist and cause damage. Brick powers are the backbone of many comic book heroes, whether these powers originate from a high-tech suit of armor, obvious morphological changes such as rocklike skin, or being made of fundamentally denser materials.
Brick.name: Brick

Chi.description: The Chi Super Power FX broad skill represents enhancement to the character's body and mind brought about by discipline and training. Practitioners of Chi are very dedicated individuals who have devoted their lives to a religion, a cause, or a form of martial art. The practitioner of Chi relies on the power of her body as well as her mind, so specialty skills are based on Strength or Will.
Chi.name: Chi

Diabolism.description: Diabolism focuses on summoning and controlling malevolent supernatural or extradimensional beings. It is relatively easy to attract these beings, but dangerous: Critical Failures normally harm the caster. Diabolism uses sacrifices as bargaining power; heroic diabolists usually pay with personal life energy (stun, wound, fatigue, or mortal points), with sacrifice quality from Marginal to Amazing. A higher-quality sacrifice grants a -1 step bonus per grade, while a lower-quality sacrifice adds a cumulative +3 step penalty per grade. Warded or holy places can impose +1 to +3 steps; places of evil can grant -1 to -3 steps; assisting cultists can grant -1 step per factor of ten participants above the required number. Only the caster may spend last resort points during a ritual.
Diabolism.meta: Manual: Diabolism; Broad Arcane Magic FX skill; Cost 12; primary abilities PER/WIL; Beyond Science p. 15.
Diabolism.name: Diabolism

Druidism.description: The druidic faith is a belief that the earth is the mother and source of all life. The faith reveres the earth and other natural things, observing and maintaining the circle of life, death, and rebirth. The miracles of Druidism require a combination of understanding how the pathways of natural energy work and sufficient will to manipulate those pathways to result in physical changes.
Druidism.name: Druidism

Energy.description: The Energy Super Power FX broad skill allows a character to manipulate, project, and resist energy in various forms, such as fire, electricity, or concussive force. These powers can be devastating in combat and offer potent defensive capabilities, reflecting the hero's ability to safely channel massive amounts of raw power.
Energy.name: Energy

Hatire.description: Hatire Faith FX reflects perseverance, patience, continuous striving, hard work, purity of spirit, and the Cosimir. Hatire miracles are easier after prayer: 1 full round of prayer before invoking gives a -1 step bonus, and 10 minutes of prayer gives a -3 step bonus. The priest must maintain concentration during this time; damage or any action other than prayer breaks concentration and wastes the miracle and its FX points. Hatire miracles are based on Will and Personality.
Hatire.meta: Manual: Hatire; Broad Faith FX skill; Cost 14; primary abilities WIL/PER; Beyond Science pp. 42-43.
Hatire.name: Hatire

Hemomancy.description: Hemomancy is blood magic dealing with life, kinship, and mystical relationships through blood. Most spells require blood from the arcanist or target, often a drop equivalent to 1 stun point and sometimes as much as a cup equivalent to 1 wound point. Doubling the required blood amount and durability equivalent grants a -1 step bonus. Prepared blood loses power if not fresh; blood more than 24 hours old is unsatisfactory unless chilled, and preservative chemicals taint it. Hemomancy spells are based on Constitution or Intelligence and suffer a +1 step penalty when used on creatures outside the hemomancer's species unless offset by an appropriate xenomedicine skill. Hemomancy only affects living creatures with bloodlike fluids.
Hemomancy.meta: Manual: Hemomancy; Broad Arcane Magic FX skill; Cost 10; primary abilities CON/INT; Beyond Science pp. 18-19.
Hemomancy.name: Hemomancy

Hermeticism.description: Hermeticism is the study of alchemy and the manipulation of physical matter through complex formulas and rituals. Hermeticists use rare ingredients, precise measurements, and careful study to alter physical matter, create artificial life-forms, or brew magical transmutations.
Hermeticism.name: Hermeticism

Illusion.description: Illusion manipulates light and sound to create artificial images and noises. It often benefits from references or models: a picture or small sculpture can grant a -1 step bonus, and an actual model can grant a -2 step bonus. Illusion spells can be combined in a single action, though each FX energy cost must be paid. Most illusions depend on the caster's attention and remain static unless controlled, though an existing illusion can be altered while its duration continues. Illusions affect things that can perceive them and work through cameras and other recording devices because they manipulate light and sound rather than minds.
Illusion.meta: Manual: Illusion; Broad Arcane Magic FX skill; Cost 8; primary abilities INT/WIL; Beyond Science pp. 24-25.
Illusion.name: Illusion

Mesmerism.description: This school of Arcane Magic FX focuses on influencing and controlling living minds. In many ways this discipline overlaps other sorts of magic and even several psionic skills. Some of the more common sorts of mesmerists include hypnotists and some public speakers (especially politicians and televangelists), although spies and assassins also find this magic very useful. Mesmerism requires some study but is nota difficult art. A practitioner with sufficient Will and natural ability quickly masters the basics of this Arcane Magic FX, although only rare individuals grasp the most difficult exercises. Mesmerists are usually willful and charismatic. A mesmerist must attract a target's attention and be strong enough to retain it long enough to overwhelm his resistance. Thus, mesmerists usually have high Will and Personality Ability Scores, and their spells are based on these two Abilities.
Mesmerism.name: Mesmerism

Metaconscious.description: Metaconscious Super Power FX involve the enhancement of the mind, senses, and personality. These powers reflect a mind operating at a superhuman level of efficiency, calculation, and intuitive grasp, granting the hero vast intellect, hyper-learning, or a dominating force of presence.
Metaconscious.name: Metaconscious

Monotheism.description: Monotheism covers miracles of an all-powerful deity in traditions such as Christianity, Judaism, and Islam. It requires strong conviction and does not need special trappings; the priest normally offers a brief prayer. Genuine relics can grant a -1 step bonus to miracles, or -2 to -3 if directly relevant or extremely powerful. Holy sites may provide similar rare bonuses. Monotheism miracles are based on Will or Personality.
Monotheism.meta: Manual: Monotheism; Broad Faith FX skill; Cost 14; primary abilities WIL/PER; Beyond Science pp. 44-45.
Monotheism.name: Monotheism

Movement.description: The Movement Super Power FX broad skill encompasses powers that allow a hero to move at incredible speeds, pass over obstacles, or travel instantaneously. This includes sprinting faster than vehicles, swimming like marine life, sticking to vertical surfaces, or teleporting across vast distances.
Movement.name: Movement

Necromancy.description: Necromancy manipulates life energy through living or dead bodies or independently of a physical shell. It can create undead, hauntings, death curses, life-draining effects, and necromantic healing. It is difficult and inhumanizing: each Critical Failure while casting a Necromancy spell requires a Personality feat check or the necromancer gains a cumulative flaw chosen by the Gamemaster from Poor Looks, Obsessed, or Phobia. Necromancers can substitute 2 fatigue points for 1 FX energy point and can use life batteries made from stolen life essence. Spells are based on Intelligence and Constitution; using them on creatures with different basic chemistry applies a +5 step penalty, reducible by proper xenomedicine.
Necromancy.meta: Manual: Necromancy; Broad Arcane Magic FX skill; Cost 10; primary abilities INT/CON; Beyond Science p. 31.
Necromancy.name: Necromancy

Pyromancy.description: Pyromancy creates and controls heat and flame. It is more versatile than the pyrokinetics psionic skill but hazardous. Characters using Pyromancy untrained suffer a Critical Failure on a control die result of 19 or 20, or 18-20 if they have Bad Luck. Pyromancy requires determination and stamina, so its spells are based on Will and Constitution. It normally does not work underwater or where oxygen is absent. Each spell describes its backfire effect on a Critical Failure.
Pyromancy.meta: Manual: Pyromancy; Broad Arcane Magic FX skill; Cost 11; primary abilities WIL/CON; Beyond Science pp. 33-34.
Pyromancy.name: Pyromancy

Shamanism.description: Shamanism allows the shaman to send her consciousness into the spirit world, interact with spirits, rouse ancestors, see the future, and call on animal spirits. Most Shamanism miracles require entering a trance with a complex Resolve-mental resolve check: Marginal trances require 2 successes, Ordinary 3-4, Good 5-7, and Amazing 8 or more. Drumming, chanting, drugs, or hypnosis can provide step bonuses at the Gamemaster's discretion. Invoking before enough trance successes applies a +1 step penalty per missing success. In trance, the shaman suffers a +1 step penalty on actions not tied to maintaining the trance or working magic. Critical Failure after an Amazing trance can trap the shaman in the spirit world until she finds her way back with Resolve-mental resolve checks.
Shamanism.meta: Manual: Shamanism; Broad Faith FX skill; Cost 13; primary abilities WIL/PER; Beyond Science pp. 47-48.
Shamanism.name: Shamanism

Taoism.description: Taoism is based on Tao, chi, te, harmony, nonintervention, wu wei, and internal discipline. A hero with the Taoism broad skill may spend a last resort point to shift her own or an opponent's roll by two degrees toward Ordinary but cannot push a roll beyond Ordinary or reduce an opponent below Ordinary. Taoist Free Agents using two last resort points can go one step beyond that limit. Taoist miracles are based on Will and Personality.
Taoism.meta: Manual: Taoism; Broad Faith FX skill; Cost 13; primary abilities WIL/PER; Beyond Science pp. 50-51.
Taoism.name: Taoism

Voodoo.description: The Voodoo Faith FX focuses on calling upon the loa (spirits) to ride (possess) the user or others to grant powers, heal, or cause harm. Voodoo requires rituals, offerings, and an understanding of the complex relationships between the different spirits.
Voodoo.name: Voodoo

Animal voice.description: This miracle allows the shaman to speak the language of a specific animal and communicate with it directly, understanding its replies.
Animal voice.name: Animal voice

Animate dead.description: Animates one creature with about human-sized brain mass, or multiple smaller creatures whose combined brain mass is equivalent. The animated dead obey simple verbal commands such as Guard, Attack, or Walk, and the body or bodies must be within 30 meters at casting. Body decay modifies the check: dead 1-6 weeks +1 step, 6-12 weeks +2 steps, 12-24 weeks +3 steps, and bodies dead more than 24 weeks are unsuitable. Duration is Ordinary 1 day, Good 1 week, Amazing 1 month. The necromancer may control a maximum number of zombies, or proportional smaller creatures, equal to animate dead rank. Medical Science-medical knowledge gives -1 step at rank 2, -2 at rank 5, -3 at rank 8, and -4 at rank 12.
Animate dead.meta: Manual: Animate Dead; Arcane Magic FX - Necromancy; Specialty cost 5; Ability INT; Transform spell; 1 FX energy point; cannot be used untrained; Beyond Science p. 32.

Everyone viewing the priest automatically shifts one step toward Fanatic on the Encounter Skill Effects table. The aura lasts 1 round plus 1 round per degree of success of the skill check.

At any time during the miracle's effect, the houngan or mambo can choose to have Ayza intervene in his or her favor. This intervention ends the miracle immediately and acts exactly like a last resort point being spent by the hero.

Binding.description: Restrains a demon so the diabolist can bargain with it or force it into service. It works normally on least demons; a lesser demon requires 2 FX energy points and a +3 step penalty; a greater demon requires 3 FX energy points and a +5 step penalty. It is normally cast on a magical circle or pentagram into which the demon is summoned; inscribing the diagram takes 1 hour. Casting on a free-roaming demon applies a +2 step penalty. A bound demon cannot leave, attack, or use magical abilities to dispel the binding. Each week, the demon makes Resolve-mental resolve at a cumulative +1 step penalty per week to resist capitulation; if spiritwrack is used, it rolls daily and the penalty increases daily. If no finite demand is made within 1 day, the demon is released. Binding a least demon requires an Ordinary sacrifice, lesser requires Good, greater requires Amazing. The target must be within 30 meters. Critical Failure makes that specific creature immune to the diabolist's spells.
Binding.meta: Manual: Binding; Arcane Magic FX - Diabolism; Specialty cost 4; Ability PER; Transform spell; 1, 2, or 3 FX energy points; cannot be used untrained; Beyond Science p. 16.

Black warding.description: Black warding creates a faint field of shimmering purplish-black light that protects the caster from all forms of attack, whether melee, ranged, psionic, or magical. The aura grants +2 to the caster's resistance modifier.

The spell is most effective if at least a drop of the specified individual's blood is used; without that blood, the target must be within 30 meters and the check suffers a +2 step penalty. For the next hour, the recipient gains a -1, -2, or -3 step bonus on all melee attacks against the specified individual for Ordinary, Good, or Amazing success, but suffers a matching +1, +2, or +3 step penalty on Personality-based skill checks used against that individual.

The hemomancer must take at least 1 wound point of the target's blood and feed it to her. It is often selected as always active; otherwise each activation lasts 10 minutes. If selected as always active, permanent FX energy cost can be reduced from 3 to 2 if the armor visibly changes the hero's form, such as rocky skin or rigid plates.

Call the sky father.description: Changes local weather in a 30-meter-radius area centered on the druid for 10 minutes. The druid can warm or cool the air, disperse or gather small clouds, speed or slow wind, or cause rain to fall or cease, but cannot create weather inappropriate for the terrain and climate. The check is always complex with one roll per round. Common seasonal weather requires an Ordinary complex check, unusual or adjacent-season weather requires Good, and any possible weather for the terrain regardless of season requires Amazing. The Gamemaster sets exact successes required. If conditions support lightning, the druid may spend 1 additional FX energy point to strike a target within 30 meters with a weaker lightning hazard; the target receives a -2 step bonus to the Constitution feat check. This lightning can be used no more than once per minute.

Command.description: Forces a victim within 30 meters to perform one simple action describable in fewer than a dozen words, such as Walk out of town or Give me your money. The activity cannot exceed 10 minutes and the spell cannot affect a target who does not understand the caster's language. The victim resists with Resolve-mental resolve; the resistance check suffers a +1, +2, or +3 step penalty based on the caster's Ordinary, Good, or Amazing success. Commands to commit violent or self-destructive action give the victim a -1 or -3 step bonus, respectively. The spell requires a Good sacrifice. On Critical Failure, the victim becomes immune to further command attempts by that diabolist.

Conceal.description: Covers an object or objects up to 30 meters away with an illusion of nothingness, making them invisible to normal vision. Infrared, ultraviolet, and other electromagnetic scans initially reveal the object. The object can be picked up, moved, painted, or manipulated without disrupting the illusion; objects inside a concealed object are concealed but reappear when removed. Finding or targeting an invisible object applies a +3 step penalty. The illusionist cannot see the invisible objects; an invisible creature can see its surroundings but not itself. Only discrete items can be made invisible, not sections of wall or a creature's body part. Lasers and similar coherent light can pierce the spell, though the recipient improves resistance against such attacks by 2 steps. The spell lasts 1 minute per degree of success and affects up to 2 cubic meters of material.

The doll requires hair, nail clippings, or an item taken from the victim; building it and reciting the appeals takes about 2 hours. Afterward the victim can be attacked through the doll with a 1-phase ceremony. The caster chooses pain, paralysis, or illness. Pain grants a -2 step bonus to the skill check and causes the target a +1, +2, or +3 step penalty to all actions for 1 hour. Paralysis renders the target immobile for 24 hours. Illness gives a +2 step penalty to the fetish check, but success immediately causes illness. The victim immediately resists with Resolve-physical resolve at +1, +2, or +3 steps based on the fetish result; an Amazing physical resolve result makes that victim immune to further uses by that priest. Focus.description: Much like the Stamina-resist pain skill, the focus Chi power allows the user to push beyond physical and mental pain and trauma to act as if those things simply didn't exist for a time. When this power is activated, all penalties from a dazed state, torture, mortal damage, fatigue damage, poison, and disease are ignored for the purpose of determining what step penalties the Chi user must take when performing an action. Total loss of stun, wound, mortal, or fatigue points has the normal effect on the hero. A hero could be suffering from 3 points of mortal damage, 2 points of fatigue, a terminal illness, and a paralytic poison, and she could still perform all normal actions without penalty. Situational penalties not related to the character's physical or mental state, such as performing surgery on an alien or hacking into a bank computer, still apply. This power lasts 4 phases. Ghost dance.description: Summons guardian spirits to protect the shaman and tribe. The spirits are invisible but hear the shaman and can interfere in the physical world. The shaman or one chosen person gains an additional +3 resistance modifier against melee and ranged attacks; all other participants gain +2 resistance to ranged attacks and +1 to melee attacks. Normally requires a ritual dance by twelve participants throughout the invocation. For every three fewer dancers, apply a +1 step penalty, to a maximum +4 if performed alone. Requires a Good trance with 7 successes and lasts 1 hour. If the miracle fails, all participants suffer 1 fatigue point.

Gris-gris.description: Creates a bag of powders, herbs, and rare materials for benign protection or a malevolent hex. Creating the bag and ceremony takes 30 minutes; a prepared bag can be activated with 1 round of ceremony. A priest can keep no more prepared gris-gris bags than his skill rank. A positive gris-gris imposes a +1, +2, or +3 step penalty on harmful magical or psionic attacks against the wearer. A negative gris-gris increases the target's Critical Failure range by 1, 2, or 3 points and is cumulative with similar effects. The victim must be within 5 meters of the bag daily or have touched it in the past. If the target realizes the hex, he can end it with Resolve-mental resolve, but the gris-gris penalty applies. Another priest can reverse it with a positive gris-gris at a +1 to +3 step penalty based on the original result. It lasts a number of days equal to skill rank. Lesser forms are juju or mojo, made with a -1 step bonus, lasting up to 1 hour per rank and applying to a narrower class of skills or effects. It can also lift Erzuli's Fetish.
Gris-gris.meta: Manual: Gris-Gris; Faith FX - Voodoo; Specialty cost 2; Ability WIL; Transform miracle; 1 FX energy point; Beyond Science p. 55.
Gris-gris.name: Gris-gris

Growing.description: Allows the hero and carried or worn gear to grow in height and mass. Ability Scores do not change. Initially the hero's height increases by 50 percent. Nonflying movement rates are multiplied by the change in size; lifting capacity is multiplied by the change in size; Strength and Dexterity resistance modifiers worsen by 1; Stealth checks suffer a +2 step penalty; melee damage increases by 2 points. Mass increases by the cube of the height change. The power lasts 10 minutes, and during that time the hero may change size within the allowable range without spending more FX points.
Growing.meta: Manual: Growing; Super Power FX - Body Alteration; Specialty cost 3; Ability CON; Active or 1 FX energy point; cannot be used untrained; Beyond Science pp. 58-59.

Guidance.description: The priest prays for advice on a particular current problem or course of action. The answer comes as a sense of rightness or wrongness about possible actions. Good success gives more precise guidance between similar choices, and Amazing success may point out an alternative not yet considered.
Guidance.meta: Manual: Guidance; Faith FX - Monotheism; Specialty cost 2; Ability PER; Augur miracle; 1 FX energy point; Beyond Science p. 46.

Guide my hand.description: Calls on a helpful ancestor, animal guide, or similar spirit to lend skill in combat. The shaman gains a -2 step bonus to one selected skill: Melee Weapons-blade, Melee Weapons-bludgeon, Unarmed Attack-brawl, Primitive Ranged Weapons-bow, or Primitive Ranged Weapons-sling. Requires an Ordinary trance with 3 successes and lasts 1 hour.

Haunt.description: Summons a minor ghost, the life energy of a deceased person, and binds it to a person, location, or object within 30 meters. The ghost frightens, harasses, and annoys the target, or hounds those within 10 meters if bound to a location or object. This causes a +1 step penalty to all actions by affected people. The ghost ignores physical barriers and can only be harmed by magical attacks. Effects that block or dismiss supernatural beings can stop it. Duration is Ordinary 1 day, Good 1 week, Amazing 1 month.

The priest summons a spirit relevant to the task, such as combat or thievery. The 1-minute ceremony can be rushed to a minimum of 1 round; each round subtracted adds +1 step to the check. Once summoned, the loa enters the host. The result grants -1, -2, or -3 bonus steps that the host assigns immediately among specialty skills as desired. The miracle lasts 24 hours. A person can host multiple loa, but each additional spirit beyond the first adds +1 step to summoning rolls.

Homunculus.description: Allows an alchemist to grow an artificial life form that obeys the creator. Materials include human bodily fluids, mandrake root, bear gall bladder, shark cartilage, and human growth hormones or similar primitive substitutes; deviation applies a +1 to +3 step penalty. The spell requires a full month of near-constant activity, at least 12 hours per day. Success creates a developed homunculus that knows the caster's language and can act independently under the creator's control; failure dissolves the unfinished creature. The FX energy point is lost permanently regardless of success, though it can be replaced by achievement points. With a successful homunculus check and 1 FX energy point, the creator can communicate telepathically with the homunculus at any distance for up to 1 hour. On Critical Failure, the homunculus flees and haunts the creator, perhaps serving an enemy.

Hunger.description: Alters the target's metabolism so it can only gain sustenance from blood. The target must consume at least 1 pint of blood from its own species per day, roughly 2 wound points or 1 mortal point, or take 1 fatigue damage per day. Consuming proper blood restores 1 fatigue point lost this way per pint. Each day the victim may attempt Resolve-physical resolve to return to normal metabolism, with a penalty based on the degree of success of the hunger roll. A hemomancer can also negate the spell with a successful hunger check. The target must be within 30 meters at casting.

Hunter's stare.description: Momentarily gives the shaman the mental state of a predator and paralyzes a target with fear. It requires no trance, only a whispered word and an act of will. The target's Will resistance modifier applies. Ordinary success makes the target lose its next action; Good freezes it for two actions; Amazing paralyzes it for three actions. The paralysis ends if the victim is injured or treated in a way that would wake a heavily sleeping person, such as rough shaking or slapping.

Hyper Learning.description: Allows the hero to assimilate new knowledge rapidly and use it as if skilled. To use it, the hero must witness or otherwise learn about the skill for at least 5 rounds (1 minute). Studying 3 minutes gives a -1 step bonus; 10 minutes gives -2; 30 minutes gives -3. On success, the hero gains one free broad skill or two ranks in one specialty skill, but no skill rank can exceed 12. Mundane skills only; it cannot learn or improve mindwalking or FX skills, and it cannot make the hero remember the skill beyond the duration. The benefit lasts 1 hour per degree of success and is not cumulative with itself.

Hypnotize.description: Puts one individual within 2 meters into a more receptive mood for mental influence. It requires an Ordinary complex skill check with 3 successes and 1 check per minute; the target's Will resistance modifier applies. It can be cast on an unwilling target at an additional +3 step penalty. Against a hypnotized target, the mesmerist gains a -3 step bonus to Mesmerism spells or encounter skill checks; others using such skills gain -1. The mesmerist can also enhance the subject's Strength or Dexterity by 1 point through suggestion for 10 minutes or remaining spell duration, whichever is less, causing 1 fatigue damage when hypnosis ends. The hypnosis lasts up to 30 minutes; the mesmerist can end it at any time. Memory of events during hypnosis is at the mesmerist's discretion.

On Critical Failure, the caster becomes the target and takes damage normally until the duration ends or she succeeds at an immolation check to negate it; that extinguishing check costs no FX points and does not create a new backfire.

Incendiary seal.description: Places a magical bomb on a book, door, box, or other closeable object no larger than 2 cubic meters. The next time it is opened or broken open, it explodes, dealing d4 mortal to anyone in contact, d6+2 wound to anyone within 2 meters, d4+2 wound to anyone within 4 meters, all En/O; the object takes the equivalent of d4 mortal. Casting requires an Ordinary complex skill check with 4 successes and 1 roll per round. It lasts 1 hour or until detonated, but the caster may spend 1 additional FX point at casting to extend it to 1 month; that point is not recovered until the seal triggers or expires. On Critical Failure during the complex check, it detonates immediately with damage based on successes gained: 0 none, 1 d4+2 wound, 2 d6+2 wound, 3 d4 mortal. Normal failure without Critical Failure does not backfire.

Ligature.description: Wraps the target in hundreds of metallic magical threads that snap tight and restrict movement. The target's Strength resistance modifier applies. Ordinary success partially binds: half movement and +2 step penalty on Strength- and Dexterity-related skill and feat checks for d4 rounds. Good renders the target immobile for d4+2 rounds. Amazing holds the target motionless for d8+2 rounds. The victim can still use abilities that do not require movement, such as psionics and mentally activated mutations or cybernetics. The strands cannot be broken by Strength alone but can be cut by edged or energy weapons; they have durability 3 and Ordinary toughness. On Critical Failure, the alchemist is entangled as if the spell result were Good.

Mummy's curse.description: Blights a touched target's life energy. The target makes Resolve-physical resolve to resist. Failure makes the target immediately suffer as if at Ill status; the affliction then progresses as disease except Constitution feat checks cannot recover the character beyond Ill. The victim wanders between Ill and Terminally Ill until dying or the spell is removed. Removal requires effects that dispel or counter hostile magic or possession, the necromancer's will, or the necromancer's death. Casting costs the necromancer 1 wound damage, which cannot be healed while the spell remains in effect.

Negate the spirit.description: Suppresses the victim's spirit, creating a mindless living slave called a zombi. A priest can control a number of zombis equal to twice skill rank. The miracle requires making a zombi potion in 1 hour, feeding it to the victim, and ritually or literally burying the victim for at least 8 hours; after next sunrise, the victim can be unearthed. The victim's Will resistance, species, and religion modify the roll: nonhumans impose +2 steps, while Voodoo believers give the priest -2 steps. On Ordinary or better, the victim becomes a zombi permanently and obeys. On Marginal, the victim is temporarily poisoned and recovers after 1, 4, 12, or 24 hours for Amazing, Good, Ordinary, or Marginal success on a Stamina-endurance check; Critical Failure on that check extends zombification for a week with weekly checks. Zombis remain living beings needing air and food, have no supernatural damage resistance, and do not react to pain. Exorcism or similar miracles can restore them, with few memories.

Phasing.description: Shifts the hero's body out of phase with the environment, allowing passage through solid objects. While phased, the hero is intangible but visible, cannot be harmed by physical attacks, and cannot make physical attacks. Mental attacks and spirit barriers still affect him. He cannot speak or breathe, though he may spend one action to phase in, breathe, and phase out without extra FX cost or ending the duration; he is vulnerable during that action. Movement is in any direction at walk rate. The phased state lasts 1 minute. Moving through Ordinary toughness requires no check; Good or Amazing toughness requires a phasing check at +2 or +4 each round. Failure means he cannot pass or, if inside, is trapped until he succeeds. Passing through living creatures inflicts d4s/d4+1s/d4+2s to both, with armor ineffective unless Good/Amazing full-body armor or natural toughness prevents contact.

Against a creature held by binding, duration is Marginal 1 round, Ordinary 1 hour, Good 1 day, Amazing 1 week; against an unbound demon it is Marginal no effect, Ordinary 1 round, Good 5 rounds, Amazing 10 rounds. The spell does not control temperature, preserves approximate shape adjusted for density, cannot affect living animal or plant tissue, and cannot create life. Duration is Ordinary 1 hour per rank, Good 1 day per rank, Amazing permanent. Physical Science-chemistry can assist for -1, -2, or -3 steps. Critical Failure creates a volatile or explosive material; anyone within 5 meters may make Acrobatics-dodge or suffer d8+1w (En/O), and the lab must be rebuilt in d4+2 weeks at cost.
